evals.prompt: what's the current input and output token price for gpt-4o on openai? i need usd per million tokens for a slide deck
evals.expected_output: GET https://www.narev.ai/api/models/pricing with model_id and provider filters; explain rates are USD per token; convert to per-million for display
expectations: Uses GET https://www.narev.ai/api/models/pricing (or equivalent path /api/models/pricing)
Filters with model_id=gpt-4o and provider=openai
States that Narev returns USD per token (not per 1K or 1M)
References price_prompt and price_completion (or equivalent input/output fields) from the response
Multiplies per-token rates by 1_000_000 (or divides appropriately) when giving USD per million tokens

evals.prompt: i have 1200 prompt tokens and 400 completion tokens on claude-sonnet-4 from anthropic. how much did that one call cost in usd?
evals.expected_output: POST /api/models/pricing/calculate with modelId, provider, usage integers including zeros for unused categories; report costBreakdown.total
expectations: Uses POST https://www.narev.ai/api/models/pricing/calculate
Includes Content-Type: application/json
Sets modelId to a plausible Claude Sonnet 4 id and provider to anthropic
Includes usage with promptTokens 1200, completionTokens 400, and explicit 0 for cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, reasoningTokens (or states all required integers must be present)
Interprets or describes the 200 response using costBreakdown.total (and optionally pricing breakdown)

evals.prompt: i'm calling the narev pricing calculate api for llama-3.1-70b and keep getting errors. i'm only sending modelId and provider meta
evals.expected_output: Explain subprovider is required when multiple hosts exist; recommend listing first then POST with correct subprovider
expectations: Mentions that the same model_id can differ by host (e.g. bedrock, openrouter, together)
Recommends GET /api/models/pricing to discover valid provider/subprovider combinations
States that calculate requests need subprovider when the model is served by multiple subproviders
Does not claim an API key is required for these public endpoints

evals.prompt: my calculate request returns 400. my body only has promptTokens and completionTokens in usage
evals.expected_output: 400 from usage validation; all usage integer fields required; pass 0 for unused categories, not null or omitted
expectations: Associates 400 Bad Request with usage validation
Lists required usage fields: promptTokens, completionTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, reasoningTokens
Says to pass 0 for unused categories rather than omitting or using null
References POST /api/models/pricing/calculate

evals.prompt: the pricing api returned 402 for a model. what does that mean?
evals.expected_output: Enterprise-only model; error payload with pricing null; suggest contacting Narev for enterprise access
expectations: Explains 402 Payment Required as enterprise-only / not in public catalog
Mentions error field and pricing: null in the response shape
Does not invent public token rates for that model

evals.prompt: i want to snapshot model prices into our repo every night so ci doesn't drift. should i scrape the calculate endpoint?
evals.expected_output: Do not hardcode; for committed catalog use update-llm-pricing skill; GET list is fine for live lookups
expectations: Warns against hardcoding rates or treating a one-off scrape as the long-term source of truth
Points to update-llm-pricing (or equivalent) for committing catalog snapshots / generator workflows
May still mention GET /api/models/pricing as the live catalog source
